description: This file defines a PHP interface 'WorkScheduleInterface' within the 'OrangeHRM\Leave\WorkSchedule' namespace. The interface declares methods related to employee work schedules, such as setting employee numbers, retrieving shift lengths, and checking the type of specific days (e.g., holidays or non-working days). It serves as a contract for implementing classes managing work schedule logic in the OrangeHRM leave module.

classes.name: WorkScheduleInterface
classes.description: A PHP interface defining methods related to employee work schedules, including setting employee number, retrieving shift length and start/end times, and checking day types such as holidays and non-working days.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number for the schedule context. Accepts an optional integer parameter representing the employee's unique identifier.

methods.name: getWorkShiftLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the work shift as a float, e.g., 8 or 8.25 hours.

methods.name: getWorkShiftStartEndTime
methods.description: Retrieves an object containing the start and end times of the work shift.

methods.name: isNonWorkingDay
methods.description: Determines if a given day is a non-working day. Takes a DateTime object representing the day and a boolean indicating if the check is for a full day.

methods.name: isHalfDay
methods.description: Checks if the specified day is a half-day workday.

methods.name: isHoliday
methods.description: Checks if the specified day is a holiday.

methods.name: isHalfDayHoliday
methods.description: Checks if the specified day is a holiday that qualifies as a half-day.
